genPrompt:
COPY-AD REMAKE. The FIRST attached image is a proven, high-spending competitor Facebook ad. Recreate it as a NEAR-IDENTICAL remake for LACALUT Flora (German pharmacy oral care). Target: a viewer who saw both would say "same ad, different brand". KEEP EXACTLY (do not reinterpret, improve, re-compose or add to): the layout grid and every zone's position and size, the background, scene, props, people, poses, crops, camera angle, lighting, colour-blocking, type hierarchy, type sizes, text positions, alignment, badges, arrows, stickers, borders and overall finish. If it is a flat graphic, stay flat; if it is a photo, stay photographic; if it is UGC / lo-fi, stay lo-fi. BACKGROUND COLOUR — MANDATORY CHANGE (the ONE thing that is ALWAYS different from the reference): replace the reference's dominant background / card colour with soft pale citrus-cream #FFF7D6 with navy #004A88 accents (toothpaste) or fresh pale mint-green #E6F4EA (mouthwash). Keep the same background TYPE (flat card stays a flat card, gradient stays a gradient, photo scene stays a photo scene with its surfaces re-tinted toward this colour), same texture and lighting — only the hue changes. Re-tint any panel borders, pills or outlines that matched the old background so they still sit naturally on the new one. Text colours stay as the reference unless contrast fails, then darken/lighten minimally. SWAP ONLY: (a) their product → the attached LACALUT reference packshot, placed in the SAME spot, SAME scale, SAME angle and SAME lighting as their product (if their product is held, ours is held the same way); (b) their brand name, logo and wording → the LACALUT wording below. Where a line is marked "keep", reproduce it exactly; where it is rewritten, keep the SAME size, weight, colour, case and position for the new words. 

PRODUCTION SPEC OF THE REFERENCE AD (follow literally — this is the layout and copy to rebuild):
1. CANVAS
Aspect ratio: 1:1 (square).
Overall style: Product photograph with graphic overlays and a stylized background.
Dominant background: A gradient transitioning from a very light grey/off-white in the top left to a light sky blue in the bottom right. Overlaid with a subtle, faint white hexagonal grid pattern that is more prominent in the top left and fades towards the bottom right.

2. LAYOUT GRID
Top headline block (COMFORT AND TOTAL CONTROL): Top left quadrant, approximately 38% of canvas height.
Sub-headline (For An Effortless 2-Minute Clean): Below headline block, left aligned, approximately 6% of canvas height.
Feature list block (icons + text): Bottom left quadrant, approximately 40% of canvas height.
Product (toothbrush + hand): Right side, spans almost full height, approximately 90% of canvas height.

3. TEXT — EVERY text element verbatim
1. "COMFORT": Top left, huge, bold, uppercase, red, sans bold, left aligned.
2. "AND TOTAL": Below "COMFORT", top left, huge, bold, uppercase, dark blue, sans bold, left aligned.
3. "CONTROL": Below "AND TOTAL", top left, huge, bold, uppercase, red, sans bold, left aligned.
4. "For An Effortless 2-Minute Clean": Below "CONTROL", left aligned, medium, regular, title case, dark grey, sans, no background.
5. "Ergonomic Handle": Bottom left, right of hexagonal icon, medium, regular, title case, dark grey, sans, left aligned, on a white rounded rectangle pill with a subtle grey border.
6. "Non-Slip Thumb Grip": Below "Ergonomic Handle", bottom left, right of hexagonal icon, medium, regular, title case, dark grey, sans, left aligned, on a white rounded rectangle pill with a subtle grey border.
7. "Precise Brushing": Below "Non-Slip Thumb Grip", bottom left, right of hexagonal icon, medium, regular, title case, dark grey, sans, left aligned, on a white rounded rectangle pill with a subtle grey border.
8. "LACALUT": On the red toothbrush handle, vertically oriented reading from bottom to top, small, regular, uppercase, white, sans, no background.

4. PRODUCT
What it is: A glossy red plastic toothbrush with white bristles.
Where it sits: Dominantly on the right side of the canvas, extending from near the top right corner to the bottom center. The head is in the top right, the handle extends diagonally down and slightly left.
Approx % of canvas height: The toothbrush itself occupies approximately 85% of the canvas height.
Angle: Held at a 3-quarter angle, with the brush head pointing upwards and slightly left, and the handle extending downwards and slightly left.
Lighting: Bright, direct, and even lighting from the front-right, creating clear highlights on the glossy plastic and soft, defined shadows.
Shadow/reflection: A soft, subtle shadow is cast by the toothbrush onto the hand. The glossy red plastic shows subtle reflections of the environment, particularly on the curved surfaces.
Held or standing: Held firmly by a human hand.

5. PEOPLE / PROPS / SCENE
Who/what: A human hand, appearing to be female, with light skin tone and neatly manicured nails (clear or very light pink polish).
Pose: The hand is gripping the lower-middle section of the red toothbrush handle. Fingers are wrapped around the handle, with the thumb resting on the top side of the handle, near the textured grip area.
Expression: N/A (only a hand is visible).
Crop: The hand is cropped at the wrist/forearm, entering the frame from the bottom right and extending upwards to hold the toothbrush.
Props and their positions: No additional props beyond the toothbrush.
Camera angle and lens feel: Slightly elevated camera angle looking down at the hand and toothbrush. The focus is sharp on the toothbrush and hand, with a subtle softening of the background, suggesting a moderate depth of field.

6. GRAPHIC DEVICES
1. Red horizontal line: Below "COMFORT", extending right, approximately 15% of canvas width, color matches "COMFORT" text.
2. Dark blue horizontal line: Below "AND TOTAL", extending right, approximately 15% of canvas width, slightly shorter than the red line, color matches "AND TOTAL" text.
3. Hexagonal icon frame 1: Positioned left of "Ergonomic Handle" text pill. Red outline, white fill. Contains a red line art icon of a toothbrush.
4. Hexagonal icon frame 2: Positioned left of "Non-Slip Thumb Grip" text pill. Dark blue outline, white fill. Contains a dark blue line art icon of a hand gripping a textured surface.
5. Hexagonal icon frame 3: Positioned left of "Precise Brushing" text pill. Red outline, white fill. Contains a red line art icon of a tooth with two small sparkle/starburst elements.
6. Heart icon: Small, white outline, positioned on the red toothbrush handle, above the "LACALUT" text.
7. Background pattern: A subtle, faint white hexagonal grid pattern, more visible in the top left and fading towards the bottom right.

7. COLOUR PALETTE
1. Red: Hex-ish #E61E2B (Used for "COMFORT", "CONTROL", red line, toothbrush body, toothbrush icon, tooth icon, red hexagonal outlines).
2. Dark Blue: Hex-ish #1A3B6F (Used for "AND TOTAL", dark blue line, hand grip icon, dark blue hexagonal outline).
3. Light Grey/Off-White: Hex-ish #F8F8F8 (Used for top left background, text pill backgrounds, icon fills, toothbrush bristles, heart icon, background hexagonal pattern).
4. Medium Grey: Hex-ish #4A4A4A (Used for "For An Effortless 2-Minute Clean" text, "Ergonomic Handle" text, "Non-Slip Thumb Grip" text, "Precise Brushing" text, subtle border on text pills).
5. Sky Blue: Hex-ish #A0C0E0 (Used for bottom right background gradient).

8. MOOD / FINISH
Lighting: Bright, clean, and professional studio lighting, emphasizing product details and gloss.
Contrast: High contrast for text elements against the background and for the red toothbrush against the lighter background. Softer contrast in the background gradient.
Photo vs render: The toothbrush and hand are a high-quality, well-lit photograph. The background, text, and icons are graphic design elements.
Any filter or grain: No apparent filter, grain, or vintage effect. The image has a sharp, modern, and clean aesthetic.

TITLE CASE ALL HEADERS (Quan's #1 header rule, never break): the headline AND every sub-headline are written in Title Case — capitalise every significant word; small words (a, an, the, and, or, in, of, to, for, with, on, at) stay lowercase unless they are the first word. This overrides the reference ad's own casing (even if their headline is in sentence case). Body lines and fine print keep the casing given in the changes. Do NOT add any headline, badge, trust seal, star row, review, CTA pill, URL, price or logo that the reference does not have. Do NOT remove any element the reference has. OUTPUT FORMAT — ALWAYS 4:5 PORTRAIT (1080×1350), even when the reference is square or landscape (Quan 15/10/2026, never break). Keep the reference's element order and styling top to bottom, and use the extra vertical space to make the main elements BIGGER — never add new elements, never leave an empty band. 4:5 portrait aspect ratio, full-bleed edge to edge. Output ONE finished image.
